checkpoint: Agentic machine onboarding, phase 2: machine identification (simulation; one live model call)
design: Typed names are matched by fixed rules without a model call. A label photo is read by Claude, which only transcribes brand, model and label text; fixed rules decide support. Near relatives ask for confirmation; a photo contradicting the typed name selects nothing; the owner still confirms the selected model before a setup code is issued.

The accessibility helper now waits for finite CSS transitions to settle before scanning; all three engines were then rerun.
